basic_info.description: 2412 Harrison St. is a boutique collection of 28 loft condominiums located in the vibrant part of the Mission surrounding the 20th St. corridor with popular shopping, dining and gyms. Originally built in 2002, unit #114 has recently been extensively renovated. Improvements include 2 remodeled bathrooms with high-end automated toilets, custom tile, stylish floating storage vanities and designer lighting. A remodeled kitchen with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, new led- lighting throughout and newly polished concrete floors and wood flooring. There are frosted-glass panel doors throughout the property and a second bedroom/office off the 2-story entrance way & gas fireplace. There are large, outfitted storage closets, & a stacked washer/dryer. The living/dining room features two-story windows with custom motorized sun-shades & sliding doors leading to your private, west-facing terrace with privacy fencing & beautiful character-filled old brick wall. The building has a roof deck, elevator, video intercom system, & this unit has a side-by-side garage parking space with EV charger & additional storage. Step outside to enjoy Gus' Market, Sight Glass Coffee, Atlas Cafe, Flour + Water, Mission Cliffs, and Farmhouse Thai, & Heath Ceramics. Walking score 98, biking score 99.
